report.explanation: All current read-only telemetry is healthy: order checkout trace OK at 71ms, error_rate 0.001, p95 72ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters across gateway/order/payment/inventory, and INFO 200 logs. This contradicts the degraded-checkout alert and supports no bounded root cause from the taxonomy. Handing off for evidence of an actual fault.
missing_evidence: No telemetry shows elevated latency, errors, timeouts, or pool waiters in any service; need evidence of an actual degraded signal to bound a cause.
No deployment records or configuration diffs to test bad-configuration or deployment-caused latency.
No memory-retention time series per service to assess a leak.
No downstream dependency latency or timeout data to test downstream-latency or redis-timeout.
